sources.description: Mapping of source filenames to their extraction rules. Each key must be a file name inside the simulators/ directory.

additionalProperties.description: List of field extraction rules for this source file.

from.description: JSONPath expression pointing to the field inside the source JSON.

to.description: Top-level key name in the merged JSON where the extracted value will be placed.

success.description: Indicates whether the module completed without errors.

errors.description: List of errors encountered during execution. Empty if execution succeeded.
